messages.snippet: Grace, Henry, Attached is the draft briefing paper / merger notice we propose to submit to the CMA.
messages.subject: Project Forge — draft briefing paper to the CMA for your approval
messages.plaintextBody:
Grace, Henry,

Attached is the draft briefing paper / merger notice we propose to submit to the CMA. It concedes jurisdiction, sets out the no-SLC case on the broad centrifugal frame, addresses the water-sector concern with the bidding evidence, and — strictly without prejudice — flags our willingness to discuss a divestment of the Aqualis line if needed. Please review, particularly the factual sections at Parts B and C, and let us have any corrections by Wednesday so we can file on 8 December.

Best
James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP

T +44 (0)20 7946 0531
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
